rule: Each entry ties an asset named in a REMIT/ENTSOG unavailability message to a published identity the product already holds: a GIE facility (by its EIC) or an ENTSOG reference point (by its point key). An entry is added only with evidence from the two publishers' own records (names, EIC codes, operator, country) and is reviewed by hand; no entry carries a position of its own, and none is derived from a name by similarity. An asset that is not listed, or whose target is not in the store, stays unlocated with its reason.
